title: Markdown rendering for articles with syntax highlighting
description: Long-form articles need better Markdown rendering than microblog posts: code syntax highlighting (syntect or similar), footnotes, table of contents generation, math rendering (KaTeX), image captions, blockquote attribution. Extend fieldwork::content or add fieldwork::article_renderer.
close_reason: Implemented: articles_db with 11 tests, writefreely_api types with 7 tests, handlers in all 3 servers (smallhold full CRUD, gaja multi-tenant, broadside read-only), schema migration v12
